findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.citation_text:
6-301.12 Hand Drying Provision. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels.

On arrival the hand sink next to the grills was observed without paper towels or another hand drying method. The PIC was shown and refilled the paper towel dispenser during this inspection to correct.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-501.114(A) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11.

On arrival the sani bucket in the food preparation area was oberved to not produce a color change on the inspector’s test strips. This was discussed with the PIC. A new jug replaced the one in the dispenser and a new bucket filled. The new bucket was observed at effective concentration and the violation was considered corrected.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-702.11 Before Use After Cleaning. UTENSILS and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be SANITIZED before use after cleaning.

The dish machine in the kitchen was not able to produce a color change on the inspector’s test strips. Multiple attempts were made and it was observed that concentrate was not metering into the water solution when it should in the cycle. The PIC was shown and instructed to contact their maintenance company. The PIC is instructed to have the machine serviced and functional prior to the follow up. The follow-up would normally land on a Saturday. Due to this it is being pushed back to Monday.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.111 (A)(B) and (D) Controlling Pests.  The facility is observed to have a number of pests around the hot water tanks/booster heaters of the dish machine. There is a plumbing line traversing from the dish machine to the left wall. Pests are observed running the length of this pipe and accumulating around the warm equipment. Sentinel for pest control was just out today for service. Administrator called for additional service specifically to the dish machine area. The facility is asked to use chemical and other methods to deter and eliminate pests around the dish machine. THEN, use the glue traps to monitor around additional equipment in the kitchen to insure pests do not migrate to these locations.  Will return in two weeks to check on progress. Cleaning is not an apparent issue. Floors, walls, and ceilings are observed clean. 

The PREMISES shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests shall be controlled to eliminate their presence on the PREMISES by: (A) Routinely inspecting incoming shipments of FOOD and supplies; (B) Routinely inspecting the PREMISES for evidence of pests; and (D) Eliminating harborage conditions.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.citation_text:
5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. 

On arrival the hand sink by the juice machines was observed to have running water flowing through a catch tray that appears to be from one of the juice machines. Designated hand sinks are to be used for only hand washing and no other task per code. The PIC was shown and removed the tray to correct. Education is suggested for staff to ensure that this situation does not persist in the future.

findings.title: Food separated and protected.
findings.citation_text:
3-302.11(A)(2) Packaged and Unpackaged Food - Separation, Packaging, and Segregation. (A) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by: (b) Arranging each type of FOOD in EQUIPMENT so that cross contamination of one type with another is prevented.

A package of raw chicken is observed on top of a package of pre-cooked chicken in the walk in cooler. The PIC saw it and removed the RTE chicken immediately to correct the violation. Education was conducted. Ensure that RTE TCS foods are stored above raw items in the coolers.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-501.114(F)(1) and (2) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11.

The sani bucket available in the kitchen at the time of this inspection would not register sanitizer on the inspector’s test strips. The bucket was remade to correct. Ensure all in use sanitizers in the facility are maintained at effective levels at all times.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.citation_text:
6-202.15(A) Outer Openings, Protected. (A) Except as specified in (B), (C), and (E) and under (D) of this section, outer openings of a FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by: (1) Filling or closing holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings; (2) Closed, tight-fitting windows; and (3) Solid, self-closing, tight-fitting doors. 

There is a broken piece of framing around the AC unit in the 4th floor dry storage room. This leaves an opening to the outside through which pests could enter the facility. The PIC was shown and instructed to have repaired prior to the next routine inspection.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used.
findings.comment:
(REPEAT FROM THE PRE-OPENING) 4-501.11(B) Good Repair and Proper Adjustment. (B) EQUIPMENT components such as doors, seals, hinges, fasteners, and kick plates shall be kept intact, tight, and adjusted in accordance with manufacturer's specifications. 

The gasket on the door for the walk in freezer is pulling away from the door. Repair prior to the next routine inspection.

findings.title: Food handler training
findings.comment:
410 ILCS 625/3.06(b). Food handler training: restaurants. (b) Unless otherwise provided, all food handlers employed by a restaurant, other than someone holding a food service sanitation manager certificate, must receive or obtain American National Standards Institute-accredited training in basic safe food handling principles within 30 days after employment and every 3 years thereafter.

Of the kitchen staff that does not have a CFPM only one has food handler training on file. A conversation took place with the PIC and they are instructed to ensure that all food handlers that do not have a CFPM have completed food handler training prior to the next routine inspection.
